payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance results for various models used in cyberbullying detection, including F1 scores and accuracy metrics for different datasets.

claims.text: The F1 score for the Wikipedia dataset using BLSTM with attention and feature level transfer learning is 0.94.
The F1 score for the Twitter dataset using BLSTM with attention and feature level transfer learning is also 0.94.
For the Formspring dataset, the achieved F1 score is 0.95 with an accuracy score of 98%.
Previous best F1 scores for the Wikipedia and Twitter datasets were 0.68 and 0.93 respectively.
